sasha: FYI vendor moved 50 H100s -> new ETA 2026-04-20, plus 12 DOA RMAs stuck in customs. This will starve APAC-edge pool next week. RMA case RMA-8271. cc @miguel @riley

miguel: on it. We have ~18 H100s spare in eu-central but cross-region reroute will raise latency for latency-sensitive routes. Propose split shipment + temporary routing of non-critical workloads to eu. Also enable quantized model path for token-heavy jobs.

ops-bot: Auto-alert: apac-syd-edge pool utilization 94% -> projected OOM in ~38h if no mitigation.

riley: Agreed. Quick wins: throttle background batch jobs, cap generation to 256 tokens for non-enterprise routes, and turn on aggressive KV cache. I can push a route canary: `redwoodctl route update --region apac-syd --max-qps 120 --canary 10%`

jen: RMA logistics: AWB 123-456789 flagged for missing COO at customs. Forwarder says paperwork is fixable but delays ~48h. Vendor offered air-upgrade for 6 units (ETA 2026-04-03) at +$1.2k/unit if we approve today.

sasha: If air-upgrade keeps APAC alive it's worth it. @jen prioritize COO docs. Finance: can we cover return-shipping for DOAs? Also need a short customer comms note about degraded perf.

jen: Pushing docs to forwarder portal now, filing ticket `TKT-4512` with customs broker. Will forward invoice to finance and ask for return-shipping estimate.

miguel: I'll prepare infra mitigation: routing changes + temporary autoscale bump on dedicated pools (+20% cap for 24h). Plan: canary 10% then ramp to 50% if metrics stable.

riley: I'll run canary at 10:30 UTC and attach rollback hook `--fallback-model gpt-lite-8`. Also add metric checks: p50 < 80ms, error-rate < 0.5%.

kai-vendor: Manifest update posted to vendor portal (link). AWB doc fixes started at vendor side. Commercial will DM about return-shipping waiver.

ops-bot: Event: vendor docs uploaded to portal at 1763216600.

sasha: Perfect. Let's reconvene in 2h to confirm AWB and canary result. If air-upgrade is green we cancel some of the infra throttle. :thumbsup:

kai-vendor: will confirm final tracking within the hour.

riley: noted, I'll post canary metrics in #eng-infra once run.

jen: Invoice and customs receipt sent to finance (email forwarded).

sasha: thanks everyone — closing this thread unless new blockers.
